description: Animate a still image into a video. Supports first-frame (and optionally last-frame) keyframe control. MODELS: gen4.5 (flagship), gen4_turbo (fast/cheap), veo3.1 (best quality + audio), veo3.1_fast, veo3 (deprecated upstream). WORKFLOW: Returns task_id → poll with check_runway_task or use wait_for_runway_task.

audio.description: Generate audio (veo models only). Default: true.

last_frame_image.description: Optional last frame image for transition.

negative_prompt.description: What should NOT appear in the output (veo models only, max 1000 chars). Omit to use the default negative prompt.

prompt_image.description: First frame image. HTTPS URL, Runway URI, or local file path.

name: generate_video_from_image
